target: Replace raw same-cut noncreation with a temporal induction proving that no same-cut double-bridge pair becomes co-eligible in a frozen exact key.

stage_model.K: exact entry key after pre-unit closure
stage_model.K_prime: reached child exact key after branch restriction and child pre-units

falsified_hypotheses.name: Raw same-cut noncreation
falsified_hypotheses.reason: Two same-cut pairs occur in raw frozen-pass outputs through GT_8.

falsified_hypotheses.name: 553 post-unit pair births
falsified_hypotheses.reason: The extra raw pairs are local resolvents. Post-units create zero double-bridge pairs on the finite frontier.

falsified_hypotheses.name: Post-unit vacuity on every pair-bearing raw output
falsified_hypotheses.reason: One GT_5 fresh/fresh complementary-unit pair closes as POST_UNIT_CONTRADICTION before a post-result exists.

raw_same_cut_transients.name: GT_4 mixed entry/fresh transient
extinction: one reached child is terminal while both residual clauses remain
the other reached child removes the fresh right clause by child pre-unit closure

proved_theorems.name: Frozen Fresh-Side Barrier
proved_theorems.statement: If an exact entry key K contains no same-cut pair and R=K union F is the frozen-pass output, every same-cut pair in R contains at least one clause from F and therefore cannot be co-eligible during the pass which created it.

remaining_local_obligations.name: T2a Post-Unit Extinction/Noncreation
remaining_local_obligations.statement: Post-unit closure cannot create a same-cut pair that survives into P; complementary-unit transients close immediately.

remaining_local_obligations.name: T2b Branch Handoff Extinction
remaining_local_obligations.statement: Every same-cut transient surviving into P is removed, becomes structurally safe, or reaches a terminal child before K'.

remaining_local_obligations.name: T3 Temporal Induction
remaining_local_obligations.statement: Root absence plus T1, T2a, and T2b preserves same-cut absence in all reached exact keys.

claim_boundary: T1 is proved for arbitrary n under the exact-key induction hypothesis and frozen parent semantics. T2a, T2b, the global cache lower bound, and P versus NP remain open.
